about.label: 01 / About
about.headline: Technical depth,
paragraphs: I am a backend-focused software engineer with experience across EV charging, digital health, fintech, and payment systems. At Nexagrids, I own core IoT and Payment services while contributing across a platform of backend and frontend repositories.

I work at the intersection of architecture, production reliability, and product delivery: resolving ambiguous requirements, reviewing system boundaries, and turning recurring operational problems into durable engineering improvements.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
highlights: Accelerated delivery of cross-service features by defining backend boundaries, API contracts, and rollout sequences early, allowing product, frontend, backend, and QA teams to move with fewer handoff blockers.
Eliminated recurring manual invoice operations by introducing resilient automation and proactive monitoring, reducing operational effort while protecting payment continuity.
Improved production stability by turning recurring incidents into system-level fixes, regression coverage, and backward-compatible releases that allowed dependent teams to deploy independently.
Raised engineering quality across 10 backend and frontend repositories by serving as a primary reviewer, establishing shared coding standards, and coaching engineers through complex changes.
Led platform-wide technical upgrades across six services without disrupting CI, using staged rollout planning to keep development and releases moving.
Standardized an AI-assisted development workflow from requirements through documentation, reducing coordination friction and making high-quality delivery more repeatable across the team.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
highlights: Refactored long-running APIs and reduced request latency by 20%.
Joined product discovery early to assess feasibility and cut follow-up adjustment time by at least half.
Improved web-team delivery efficiency by at least 30% through ongoing backend support and clearer interfaces.
Led month-long backend initiatives and shortened junior engineers’ delivery timelines by one to two weeks.
Delivered backend services for Egypt and Korea one month early, creating more time for product validation.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
highlights: Built backend services for Clinic Promotion, Telemedicine, and Self-Titration products.
Designed and maintained service architecture across Health2Sync, HealthPass, and SyncPoint.
Supported a digital-health platform serving more than one million users and 50,000 daily active users.
Helped establish project structures and provided technical guidance to new team members.

experience.title: Junior Go Web Engineer
highlights: Developed payment capabilities that connected multiple consumer payment methods through a unified backend workflow.

experience.title: IT Specialist
highlights: Developed and maintained business-critical banking systems supporting debit and credit-card operations.
Built an early foundation in reliable software delivery within a highly regulated financial environment.
